title: Introduce proactive hint layer and toggle press-targets
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: Form inputs across product surfaces show inconsistent early guidance and varying hit-targets for toggles and switches. On narrow mobile screens and dense desktop forms we see users miss toggles or submit incomplete fields because hints and affordances are delayed until validation. This leads to avoidable support tickets and reduces completion rates for multi-step flows.

Goals: 1) Define a lightweight, proactive hint layer for text fields/selects that surfaces contextual guidance (examples, constraints) before error state. 2) Standardize expanded press/hit targets for toggles and small controls (mobile-first) without regressing visual density on desktop. 3) Map token migrations for hit-target padding and hint layering to existing density tokens so teams can opt-in per surface. 4) Ensure keyboard + screen reader behavior remains predictable and no extra noise is introduced by proactive hints.

Constraints: - Must work with compact and default density tokens. - Should not require per-component custom CSS for every usage; prefer a small set of tokens. - Keep runtime footprint small: hints should be presentational DOM elements that can be toggled by JS only when necessary. - Accessibility: hints must be reachable via aria-describedby and not disrupt focus order.

Proposed solution overview: - Introduce a new presentational layer called "proactive-hint" that renders below the input's label and above the helper/validation row. Hints are optional, short (<= 120 characters), and may include a short example snippet. - Token additions: --hint-visibility (enum: auto|always|never), --hit-padding-compact, --hit-padding-default. These tokens map to actual padding values: compact = 6px extra hit padding, default = 10px. - Toggle/button hit target: wrap small toggles with a transparent interactive padding area that increases touch target to at least 44x44 on mobile breakpoints while preserving visual bounds. On desktop the wrapper collapses to the visual bounds to maintain density. - Validation timing: proactive hints are shown by default when field is focused (auto mode). Hints collapse gracefully when a persistent validation error appears. - Implementation notes for devs: provide a single CSS utility class .rf-proactive-hint and a small ARIA pattern: input aria-describedby points to hint id when present. JS will add aria-describedby on focus and remove when the field blurs (if hintVisibility == "auto").

Design artifacts required: 1) Figma frames for compact/default density showing hint interaction, toggle wrappers, and error transition. 2) Microcopy guidance examples and length constraints. 3) Token migration table mapping new tokens to ds-token names and legacy variables.
design_decisions: Proactive hints are presentational and non-blocking: they do not change form submission behavior.
Default behavior: hintVisibility = auto (shows on focus), teams may set to always for onboarding surfaces.
Toggle touch-expansion occurs at mobile breakpoints (<= 480px) using hit-padding token; desktop keeps visual bounds.
Use aria-describedby for hint accessibility and avoid adding extra live regions to prevent announcement noise.
Validation overlay will take precedence over hint layer when an error is present; transition uses opacity + height collapse for animation.
We will not introduce new component variants: the hint layer and hit-target wrapper are additive utilities for existing inputs and toggles.
acceptance_criteria: Figma frames for default and compact density produced and linked in ticket.
Front-end prototype implemented in the playground demonstrating: hint show/hide on focus, aria-describedby wiring, toggle hit expansion on mobile breakpoint.
Token migration doc created mapping new tokens to current density tokens and example overrides.
Accessibility review sign-off from a11y engineer confirming no additional SR noise and correct keyboard focus behavior.
QA checklist with tests for keyboard flow, screen reader announcement, and mobile tap area validated (>=44x44).
